environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed on EKS 1.28 in a private VPC subnet with pgBouncer 1.21 (transaction mode, prepared_statement_count=256). The cluster uses Cilium CNI v1.14 with a CiliumNetworkPolicy that applies L7 HTTP-aware egress filtering on the pod label app=webhook-gateway: egress is allowed only to destinations matching CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 on port 5432 (database) and to external IPs resolved via a CiliumDNS policy allowing *.customer-webhooks.example.com. All other egress including link-local 169.254.169.254/32 is denied at the eBPF datapath level. Additionally, the EKS node group has instance metadata options set to HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2) with hop-limit=1, meaning even if a request somehow reached the metadata endpoint, the containerized process cannot obtain the required token due to the hop limit. The /internal/* path prefix is further gated by an Istio AuthorizationPolicy requiring a valid SPIFFE identity from the event-dispatcher service account (principal: cluster.local/ns/platform/sa/event-dispatcher).
